title: A determinant identity for the sum of contour integral matrices
summary: We derive an identity for the determinant of the sum of two $n\times n$ matrices, $U$ and $M$, whose entries are defined via contour integrals. Specifically, we consider $U(i,j)=\frac{1}{2π\mathrm{i}}\oint_{\mathrm{C}} \frac{\prod_{\ell=1}^{i-1} (z-β_\ell)}{\prod_{\ell=1}^{j} (z-β_\ell)} p_i(z)f_j(z)\mathrm{d} z$ and $M(i,j)= \frac{1}{2π\mathrm{i}}\int_Γ q_i(z)g_j(z) \mathrm{d} z$. Under suitable assumptions on the functions $p,q,f,g$, we show that $\det(U+M)$ can be expressed as a Fredholm determinant $\det(\mathrm{I} +K)$, where $K$ is an integral kernel acting on the contour $Γ$.
